title: Computing & IT Diploma (Level 3–5)
subject: Computing
summary: Build practical computing skills level by level, with a route into a top-up degree.
description: Start at Level 3 if you are new to computing, then progress to Level 4 (HNC) and Level 5 (HND).
After Level 5 you can complete a one-year top-up to earn a full bachelor's degree.
entryRequirements: Level 3: usually no formal qualifications needed, just a good level of English
Level 4 and 5: a Level 3 qualification or the previous level
